card.name: Unit words completing a dose amount
card.fires_on: The unit or period word that finishes a dose expression, such as mg after a number, hours after 'per 24', or day after 'per'. Also 'of' in 'same day of the week'.

modes.label: Dose unit after number
modes.description: mg, mEq or similar unit right after a numeric amount, often in a ratio or combination dose.
modes.example: avibactam 4.75<< mg>>/kg to a maximum dose of ceft

modes.label: Per-period word
modes.description: hours or day completing a 'per' time span for a dose limit.
modes.example: Maximum recommended dose is 8 g per<< day>>.

modes.label: Same day of the week
modes.description: The word 'of' in a cycle-restart phrase about starting on the same day of the week.
modes.example: the patient will start all subsequent cycles on the same day<< of>> the week as the first course.

card.plain: It lights up on the unit or time word that completes a dose, like the mg in '4.75 mg' or the day in 'per day'.
